T: Feathers on, platforms laced, prawns in the glass.
D: A shy piano prodigy from Pinner becomes a glam rock superstar, with his songwriting partner beside him and a lot to work through.
P: Serve the prawn cocktail when Elton walks out at the Los Angeles club for his first American show.

Nan's Pinner cheese and pineapple hedgehog
foil-wrapped half grapefruit bristling with cheddar, pickled onions and cherries, while Reggie plays
The fifties party piece every English nan made: a foil-wrapped half grapefruit bristling with sticks of cheddar, pineapple, pickled onions and cocktail cherries.
M: seared rump in paprika, mustard and sour cream with mushrooms, egg noodles, up in the hills
The dinner party star of 1970s Hollywood: seared strips of rump in a paprika, mustard and sour cream sauce with mushrooms, over buttered egg noodles.
crumbed breast filled with garlic parsley butter, peas and mash, while Your Song gets written

Crumbed chicken breast filled with garlic and parsley butter, with buttered peas and mash. Mash the butter with the crushed garlic and chopped parsley, roll into a log in baking paper and freeze for 20 minutes. Cut a deep pocket in each breast, push in a slice of the butter and press closed. Dip in flour, egg and panko, twice. Brown in the oil for 2 minutes a side, then bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Boil the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with milk and salt. Cook the peas for 3 minutes. Serve the Kievs with the mash and peas, butter running out.
W: vanilla and strawberry ice cream, berries, raspberry sauce, cream and wafer, loud as the costumes
The British seaside sundae built sky high in a tall glass: vanilla and strawberry ice cream, berries, raspberry sauce, cream, nuts and a wafer on top.
K: tequila and fresh orange over ice, grenadine poured slow to settle red, seventies Hollywood style
Tequila and fresh orange over ice with grenadine poured slowly down the side so it settles into a red and orange sunrise.

dishes.make_ahead: Best made on the night; slice the beef and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them covered in the fridge

steps.text: Toss the beef with the flour, paprika and a little salt and pepper.
Sear the beef in batches in 2 tbsp of the oil over very high heat, 1 minute a side, and lift out.
Melt the butter with the rest of the oil and cook the onion and mushrooms until browned.
Add the garlic, tomato paste and mustard for a minute, pour in the stock and simmer 5 minutes.
Return the beef and its juices, take off the boil and stir in the sour cream. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the noodles while the sauce simmers, drain and serve the stroganoff over them with parsley.

Pour in the stock, simmer 5 minutes, then return the mushrooms and stir in the sour cream off the boil. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the noodles while the sauce simmers, drain and serve the stroganoff over them with parsley.

s.note: King prawns on iceberg, cucumber and avocado with pink Marie Rose sauce, paprika, lemon and buttered brown bread
s.how: Stir 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp hot chilli sauce and the juice of half a lemon together for the Marie Rose sauce. Shred 1 iceberg lettuce finely and split between 4 coupes or wide glasses with half a diced telegraph cucumber and 1 diced avocado. Fold 500g peeled cooked king prawns through half the sauce, pile on top, spoon over the rest and dust with paprika. Hook a prawn on each rim and serve with lemon wedges and triangles of buttered brown bread.

s.n: Nan's Pinner cheese and pineapple hedgehog
s.note: Cocktail sticks of sharp cheddar, pineapple, pickled onions, cherry tomatoes and cocktail cherries spiked into a half grapefruit, with crackers
s.how: Cut 1 grapefruit in half and wrap the cut side of one half in foil, then sit it cut side down on a plate. Cut 300g sharp cheddar into 2cm cubes. Thread cocktail sticks with a cube of cheddar and a chunk of drained tinned pineapple, others with cheddar and a pickled onion, and a few with a cherry tomato or cocktail cherry on top. Spike them all over the grapefruit until it looks like a hedgehog. Serve with a stack of water crackers.

m.note: Seared beef rump strips with mushrooms, onion, paprika, mustard and sour cream, over wide egg noodles with parsley
m.how: Toss 700g thin strips of beef rump with 2 tbsp flour, 2 tsp paprika, salt and pepper. Sear in batches in 2 tbsp very hot oil for 1 minute a side and lift out. Melt 40g butter with the last tbsp of oil, then cook 1 sliced onion and 300g sliced button mushrooms for 8 minutes until browned. Add 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 1 tbsp dijon mustard for a minute, then pour in 250ml beef stock and simmer 5 minutes. Return the beef with its juices, take off the boil and stir in 200g sour cream. Cook 400g wide egg noodles while the sauce simmers. Serve over the noodles with chopped parsley.

w.note: Layers of vanilla and strawberry ice cream, mixed berries, raspberry sauce and whipped cream, topped with chopped nuts, a wafer and a cherry
w.how: Simmer 250g frozen raspberries with 60g icing sugar and a squeeze of lemon for 5 minutes, push through a sieve and cool. Whip 300ml thickened cream to soft peaks. In 4 tall sundae glasses, layer a spoon of raspberry sauce, a few strawberries and blueberries, a scoop of vanilla ice cream, more berries and sauce and a scoop of strawberry ice cream. Top with cream, a drizzle of sauce, chopped roasted peanuts, a wafer and a cherry, and serve with long spoons.

d.note: Tequila and fresh orange juice over ice, grenadine sunk to the bottom in a sunrise, orange wheel and cherry
d.how: Squeeze 5 oranges and 1 lime. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and pour 45ml tequila into each, then top with the juice. Pour 20ml grenadine slowly down the inside of each glass so it sinks and rises up in a red to orange sunrise. Garnish with an orange wheel and a cocktail cherry and serve without stirring.
